description: Median loan, rate at approval, spread over Prime, term and the most active lenders on SBA loans approved to businesses like this one in recent fiscal years. Give a 6-digit NAICS code or industry words, plus optional state, amount and business age. If that group is too thin, it says which broader group it used. Approved loans only: never a read on approval odds.

business_age.description: existing: more than 2 years in business. new: 2 years or less. startup: the loan opens the business. change_of_ownership: buying an existing business. Optional

industry.description: Industry words if the NAICS code is unknown, e.g. 'plumbing'

name: find_similar_loans
title: Find SBA loans like yours
